node.statement: The product-defect and product-right-inverse nodes show X=U bold-dot V lies in calU_t by def-approximate-unitary-space. The adjoint node shows U^dagger lies in calU_t, because its defining defect is ||(U^dagger)^dagger bold-dot U^dagger-J||=||U bold-dot U^dagger-J||<2t and U is its right inverse. Thus both required right inverses are also explicitly recorded.
